verdict.rationale: AgentMail's own docs describe registrable outbound HTTP webhooks: you register a URL and AgentMail sends a POST request as soon as an event happens. Multi-tenancy docs describe routing webhook events per pod, which confirms a programmatic consumer can receive them. missing for 10: a documented catalog of subscribable event types, delivery details such as signature verification and retries, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: you can register a URL, and we will send you a `POST` request with the details as soon as an event happens.
Instead of constantly asking the AgentMail API if there's a new email (a process called polling), you can register a URL, and we will send you a POST request
create a `Pod` per customer, give them a scoped API key, and route webhook events to the right place.
AgentMail gives each bot a real inbox with its own address, threading, inbound webhooks, and reply-to-message.
